content:
maria (PM): Quick sync request — we need a compact design review for Scoped Auth Tokens (API + SDK surface + Console UX). Target: align API contract, SDK ergonomics, and console flows before eng sprint next week. Can we do a 30–45m slot?

noah (EM): +1. Suggest 30m focused + follow-up async issues. Who needs to present?

maria (PM): I'll do the product brief. @kevin will show Console mockups, @devin will cover API changes, @sara can speak to backend rollout constraints.

devin (Eng): 30m ok if we stick to endpoints + migration plan. Need to confirm backward compatibility policy for token payload. Also want to show a short snippet of proposed request/response.

kevin (UX): 30m works. I'll keep mockups to 3 screens. Can someone confirm if we want a small in-console migration notice?

sara (Eng): FYI backend needs ~2 days of infra prep if we add token revocation endpoint. If we can't get that, we'll need a fallback plan.

maria (PM): Good call. Here's the pre-read checklist — please skim before the meeting. Will post links after this message.

maria (PM): ```
Pre-read checklist (to review before session):
- Read product brief (2-3 mins) + goals
- API contract draft: endpoints, auth headers, error codes (skim)
- SDK ergonomics: method names, async vs sync behavior
- Console flows: mockups + copy for migration notice
- Migration plan: backward compatibility, revocation plan, rollout phasing
- Open questions list (add to thread)
```

maria (PM): Links: https://redwood.company/notes/scoped-auth-product-brief (product brief) | https://git.redwood.dev/rfcs/scoped-auth (API draft) | Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/scoped-auth-mocks

noah (EM): To schedule: I can run a quick Doodle/Calendly poll — or we can take these slots: Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 14:00–14:45, Thu 09:30–10:00 (PT). Which do folks prefer?

devin (Eng): Wed 14:00 best for me. :thumbsup:

kevin (UX): Wed 10:00 conflicts with design crit. Prefer Wed 14:00 or Thu morning.

sara (Eng): Wed 14:00 works. 

maria (PM): Wed 14:00 then. I'll book the 45m to leave room for Qs (we can end early).

deploy-bot: Available room "design-huddle-2" booked for 2024-04-03T14:00Z — calendar invite sent to participants.

maria (PM): Agenda (compact):
1) 5m product goals + success metrics
2) 10m API contract + migration constraints (devin)
3) 10m SDK ergonomics & code sample (devin)
4) 10m Console mockups & copy (kevin)
5) 5m rollout risk + next steps (sara/noah)

kevin (UX): Adding one ask: decision on whether the console notice is dismissible for 24h or persistent. I'll present both options with trade-offs.

devin (Eng): For the API sample I'll paste this snippet in the meeting notes:```http
POST /v1/tokens/scoped
Authorization: Bearer <root-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "scopes": ["files:read", "models:infer"], "expires_in": 3600 }
```
Response 201 contains the scoped token and metadata. We'll need to agree on token lifetime defaults.

sara (Eng): Also will bring data on ops cost for token revocation lists — quick numbers.

maria (PM): Action items before Wed 14:00: everyone add open questions to this thread; devs post any breaking API compatibility concerns; kevin attach the Figma frames we want reviewed.

devin (Eng): I'll open a short PR in the rfcs repo with the compatibility notes by EOD today.

kevin (UX): Uploaded frames: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/scoped-auth-mocks?node-id=42%3A7 — see "Console Notice" frame.

maria (PM): cool. Quick poll: do we want an optional 15m follow-up deep-dive with infra next week for rollout sequencing? Reply with :+1: for yes.

sara (Eng): :+1:

noah (EM): :+1:

devin (Eng): :+1:

kevin (UX): :+1:

maria (PM): Great — I'll schedule that as a 15m after the main review (next Fri 11:00 PT) if infra confirms.

maria (PM): If anyone can't make it, please DM me and post any blocking items here. Thanks! :sparkles:
